To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) oysters from the Kristianstad basin were attached to plant axes; 2) these plant axes were rafted into the sea and were not in-situ mangrove stems and/or roots; 3) the foraminiferal and fish assemblages are not consistent with a mangrove environment; and 4) the depositional environment of the Kristianstads Basin was inner neritic sandy substrate and not a mangrove-like deposional environment.
